svg.title: United States Congress overview emblem
svg.desc: Map-derived United States silhouette in Albers projections, with Alaska and Hawaii inset, decorated with muted U.S. flag colors matching the Texas heritage mark. Decorative navigation artwork, not an electoral map or official seal.
svg.metadata: Geometry: vega/vega-datasets data/us-10m.json, blob ff7a7e679c46f2d1eb85cc92521b990f1a7a5c7a. Derived land boundary; state borders dissolved topologically. Includes all 50 states and DC; territories excluded. Alaska and Hawaii are separately projected, reduced and repositioned as insets.
